vocabulary.good: sound fruit, saleable as first quality
vocabulary.poor: saleable at a lower grade: immature, blemished, discoloured, minor defects
vocabulary.poor_or_rotten: the source says the fruit is defective but not whether it is a minor defect or rot; kept as its own merged label, never split

potatoes.unit: one 50x50 crop per object, as published

Good.reason: dataset definition: healthy, undamaged potatoes, suitable for market sale

Damaged.reason: dataset definition: visible mechanical or biological defects (cut, rotten, or diseased); the source does not separate cut from rotten, so it is not split

Plant.reason: plant residues, tops, weeds or leaves; not fruit quality, kept in the separate foreign-object set

Stone.reason: stones or soil clods; not fruit quality, kept in the separate foreign-object set

lemons.unit: one lemon per image (1056x1056); all photos of one fruit number share a split
lemons.rule: worst annotated condition decides the image label: rotten > poor_or_rotten > poor > good; an image with no defect region is good

gangrene.reason: task default; gangrene is tissue death

illness.reason: not in the task defaults; the README marks it as a region of an unhealthy fruit but gives no definition, so minor defect and rot cannot be told apart

dark_style_remains.reason: not in the task defaults; the README says the dark area marks an unhealthy fruit and the region where rotting or mould starts, without saying whether rot is present

greening.reason: task default; the README defines it as non-uniform yellow with green areas. Not present in the v1.0.0 COCO export (the image-level flags were not exported), so no image receives it

healthy.reason: task default. The healthy flag is not in the v1.0.0 export; the README says 'If not [healthy] regions with identified issues are annotated', so an image with no illness, gangrene, mould, blemish or dark_style_remains region is taken as healthy. This is a derived label

artifact.reason: image processing artefact, not a fruit property

image_quality.reason: photo quality tag (6 annotations), not a fruit property

condition.reason: 2 stray image-level annotations without attributes in the export; not usable as a label

fruitnet.unit: one phone photo per image, often 2 to 5 fruits of the same quality, varied backgrounds

Bad.reason: task default; 'Bad quality fruits' folder does not separate minor defects from rot

Mixed.reason: task default; 'Mixed quality' images contain several fruits of different quality, so one label per image is not defined
